name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.order.ConfirmOrderActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens order confirmation after the user selects a product and quantity. It loads or edits the shipping address, calculates the total, accepts a payment method, and submits the purchase.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the purchase confirmation and payment flow.
